answer: Farming becomes a reef bet on surviving 102 epochs of grading, and every zephyr settlement recomputes the ember schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 102 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 10 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
